name: Birder Hamish

intro.text: Shh! Shh. Oh, it's a battle. I'm in the middle of counting terns. Fine, but quietly, in a hushed and respectful manner.

win: Respectfully done. I lost count of the terns, though.
after: Arctic terns fly from Shetland to the Antarctic and back every year, about 70,000 kilometres. They see two summers a year. They also, if you get too close, see your hat.
